items.title: Gilead Sciences (GILD) Grants Royalty Free Ebola Drug Licenses For Lower Income Countries
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) announced royalty-free licensing deals for its investigational Ebola treatment obeldesivir in low and lower-middle-income countries. The agreements aim to widen future access to obeldesivir through local generic manufacturers if the antiviral gains regulatory authorization. Gilead also updated existing voluntary licenses for remdesivir to keep access in step with changing clinical and access needs. The new royalty-free licenses for obeldesivir sit alongside...
